security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown examples, Vue typing guidance, and reference links. No prompt injection, credential access, or data exfiltration intent was found.

content.value_statement: Vue projects often hit template, Volar, router, and TypeScript edge cases that slow reviews. This skill gives focused Vue 3 rules for safer components, configs, and tests.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to extract props, emits, and slots types from Vue components.
Guides vue-tsc strict template settings for undefined components and attributes.
Documents Volar 3, module resolution, and editor configuration fixes.
Provides Vue Router typed parameter patterns for unplugin-vue-router projects.
Covers Pinia store mocking, CSS module typing, and Vue directive comments.
Suggests Vite and Nuxt HMR troubleshooting steps for Vue SSR apps.
limitations: Does not validate a project against the rules automatically.
Advice depends on installed Vue, Volar, Vite, router, and TypeScript versions.
Some examples require confirmation before changing config or deleting generated caches.
Focused on Vue 3 and related TypeScript tooling, not Vue 2 migrations.

use_cases.title: Review Vue Components
use_cases.description: Find typing gaps in props, emits, slots, template bindings, and wrapper components before merge.

use_cases.title: Stabilize Vue Tooling
use_cases.description: Resolve Volar, vue-tsc, Vite, and module resolution issues after dependency upgrades.

use_cases.title: Improve Test Coverage
use_cases.description: Apply typed patterns for Pinia store mocking, data attributes, and strict template checks.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Component
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single Vue file
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Vue component for TypeScript and template typing issues. Focus on props, emits, slots, and strict template errors.

prompt_templates.title: Fix vue-tsc Errors
prompt_templates.prompt: Help fix these vue-tsc errors from my Vue 3 project. Explain which rule applies and the smallest config or code change.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor a Wrapper
prompt_templates.prompt: Refactor this wrapper component to preserve prop, emit, slot, and fallthrough attribute types. Avoid broad type assertions.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Vue app migration plan for Volar 3, Vite SSR HMR, typed router params, Pinia tests, and module resolution.

output_examples.input: A component wrapper loses button attribute completion.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends enabling fallthrough attribute support and checking how attributes are forwarded to the inner element.

output_examples.input: A route page reports that id does not exist on route params.
output_examples.output: The skill suggests using a route-specific typed useRoute pattern before falling back to a narrow type assertion.

output_examples.input: A Vue SSR app reloads fully after script setup changes.
output_examples.output: The skill separates Vite SSR configuration checks from optional cache cleanup steps that need explicit confirmation.

best_practices: Check Vue and language tool versions before applying version-specific guidance.
Prefer project-level typing and helper APIs over broad local type assertions.
Ask for confirmation before running cleanup commands or package changes.
anti_patterns: Disable strict template checking instead of fixing typed component boundaries.
Duplicate Vite Vue plugins across config files and inline build options.
Run destructive cache cleanup commands without explaining the affected folders.

faq.question: Does this skill support Vue 2?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on Vue 3, vue-tsc, Volar, Vite, and modern TypeScript tooling.

faq.question: Can it fix errors automatically?
faq.answer: It provides targeted guidance and examples. The assistant must still inspect your project and apply changes carefully.

faq.question: Does it require Claude or Codex?
faq.answer: The content is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through the marketplace skill format.

faq.question: What Vue problems does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers component typing, strict templates, Volar upgrades, router params, Pinia tests, CSS modules, and Vite SSR HMR.

faq.question: Are package install commands included?
faq.answer: Some rules mention package commands as examples. Review version impact before installing or downgrading dependencies.

faq.question: How should teams apply it?
faq.answer: Use it during code review, migration planning, and troubleshooting when Vue TypeScript tooling gives unclear errors.
